name: Apollo Finvest (India) Limited
about: Apollo Finvest (India) Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers financial services in the digital lending space; and manages investments. It also develops Apollo Cash, a digital personal loan app. The company was formerly known as Apollo Mercantile Limited. Apollo Finvest (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
